_comment: The template is the message part of every fingerprint (docs/server-sdk/
conformance.md), so an implementation that templates a message differently
splits one problem into two. fingerprint_vectors.json pins whole
fingerprints; this file pins the templating of single messages, so a
divergence names the rule that drifted.
`template` cases are message in, template out. Hand-written, not generated.
The email rule's left edge (#148): the local part stops at `=` and `:`, so
The backend reads this file now; every SDK adopts it in the follow-up named
in docs/server-sdk/conformance.md ("Email rule"), after which it is
checked everywhere and fingerprint_vectors.json gains a key=value vector.

template.name: a Go slog attribute line keeps every key
key:value with no space keeps the key
a JSON line keeps its key as its own hole
a connection string still templates as a url
